meta.title: Antigravity Executor
meta.description: Delegate coding tasks to the signed-in Antigravity desktop agent. Works in the dsh session directory, with a configurable thinking tier, RPC-driven turn settlement that returns within seconds, untruncated long reports, live account quota with 5h and weekly guards plus a cached read, a destructive-vs-escape kill switch that is armed by default, human-like inter-turn pacing, dead-session self-heal, and artifact inlining that keeps the planner context small.
